description: This file defines a Flask-based health check endpoint using Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and MethodView. It sets up a route '/' that responds with a health status message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView class that handles GET requests to perform a health check.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests and returns a simple JSON indicating the service is healthy.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Healt Check", "health check", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route"/
